selector.rationale: The presence of erythematous papules, scales, and fissures on the lower lip, along with a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the dermis, supports the diagnosis of Discoid Lupus Erythematosus, despite normal antinuclear antibodies and complement levels.

rejected.label: Photodermatitis
rejected.why: Limited evidence, only one finding of erythema after UV-A irradiation

rejected.label: Cutaneous lymphoma
rejected.why: Similar histological findings, but less specific and not as well-supported by clinical presentation
